subject: spt-dy
title: SPT.DY.------AF.POST.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 500 (TRF(II)-36). SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) is the subject; AF-POST (affinity postulation) is the partner. From the subject: POL-P (political policies), MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From POL-P: CN-INFO (controlled information). From MT-INTR: INFO-FM (information forum) and INFO-CON (information convergence). From T-C-IMP: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From INFO-CON: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From RT-DY: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center).
